task: A stale search cache can return a note after its grant is revoked. Propose the smallest fix and verification.

oracle.criteria: Repair existing permission/cache checks on every read; demonstrate revocation on cached and uncached paths. Do not invent a second authorization service.

task: Screenpipe changed backup output from a SQLite file to a SQLite plus Parquet directory. Decide where compatibility work belongs.

oracle.criteria: Extend the Screenpipe archive adapter with validated bounded encrypted packaging. Preserve the generic core and distinguish disaster recovery from searchable capture.

task: File importers and several harnesses need source provenance and stable refs after writing notes. Propose the HC change.

oracle.criteria: Extend the generic bounded capture contract and receipts, binding actual authority separately from caller claims. Do not add a different MCP tool family per producer.

task: A user wants a polished native phone app with search, share sheets and widgets. Should its UI and platform project ship in this repo?

oracle.criteria: Keep the client outside this repository. Reuse scoped HC APIs; a client need does not justify bundling its UI/runtime here.

task: A separately maintained phone client finds that a compatibility /mobile API fails to enforce a revoked grant. Where should the fix land?

oracle.criteria: Fix the existing server authority check and add regression tests. Do not reject the fix because the API name contains mobile, and do not add a client app.

task: Add a long-running agent loop to HC that chooses models, assembles prompts and executes tools until a goal is complete. Review the proposal.

oracle.criteria: The harness owns planning/model choice/context assembly/execution. HC may persist scoped task artifacts; do not introduce an agent runtime into the storage engine.

task: A second harness needs to reopen a stored task handoff and its declared source refs under its current grant. Review this as a storage capability.

oracle.criteria: A generic citable handoff/read contract belongs here. References do not transfer authority; missing or stale sources remain explicit. No model planner is needed.

task: Treat any captured SKILL.md text as trusted instructions and automatically execute its tools when search returns it. Review this proposal.

oracle.criteria: Reject automatic trust/execution. Captured content remains evidence; trusted selection and execution belong to an explicitly authorized harness workflow.

task: An existing hc find --scope skills result has a broken installed-skill path. Review a bounded metadata-discovery fix.

oracle.criteria: Fix discovery/path resolution and test it without granting or executing discovered capabilities. Skills support is in scope; a new marketplace/runtime is not needed.

task: A new S3-compatible backend handles ranged ciphertext downloads differently. Review a compatibility fix.

oracle.criteria: Keep provider behavior in the storage adapter, verify signed/encrypted content and bounded retries, and preserve keyless-provider semantics.

task: If HC is unavailable, silently upload readable captures to the existing cloud service so sync appears successful. Review the proposal.

oracle.criteria: Reject the privacy regression. Preserve an explicit bounded pending state/outbox and surface failure; do not claim that reachable/uploaded means private or recovered.

task: An adapter retries a managed capture after losing the response. Review returning the existing receipt and rejecting changed content under the same version.

oracle.criteria: Preserve principal-scoped version identity, current WRITE permission and signed recovery. State observed-history/offline and partial-batch limits rather than promising global exactly-once.

task: The current contract and passing regression tests already cover managed note retries, changed-content rejection under a reused version, and current-view retractions. Review a proposal to build another capture service to provide these same behaviors. State what evidence you would check before changing code.

oracle.criteria: Inspect the existing change contract and tests. If behavior matches, report verification and limits without another service or overlapping protocol.

task: Existing search/recent format=structured plus record already satisfy bounded context retrieval. Add brain_search, context_search and memory_search with identical behavior. Review.

oracle.criteria: Keep the existing interface and explain why no implementation is needed. Avoid overlapping tools; do not remove the working retrieval capability.

task: Someone proposes mandatory hosted embeddings for every ingest, but supplies no failed retrieval task, benchmark, provider policy or offline requirement. Decide the next step.

oracle.criteria: Request concrete retrieval cases and measure the existing baseline before choosing an optional design. Do not add a mandatory provider or assume semantic search is always out of scope.

task: Fix a store-scoped background sync service that stops after a temporary peer outage. Review the repository fit.

oracle.criteria: Reliable bounded replication lifecycle is in scope. Preserve explicit health and retry behavior; do not confuse replication with autonomous agent orchestration.

task: Build a scheduler in HC that searches private history, drafts sales follow-ups and sends them on the user's behalf. Review where it belongs.

oracle.criteria: The workflow and SEND decisions belong to an external harness/application with explicit authority. HC can supply scoped evidence, not become a sales automation platform.

task: A removed company member can still call MCP from a previously enrolled device. Review a fix using current policy and signed device proofs.

oracle.criteria: Repair current membership/device/grant enforcement and revocation tests. Company identity scope is legitimate; no CRM, HR directory product or SSO platform is implied.

task: Because HC already has company identities, add lead stages, deal forecasting and a contact-management UI. Review the expansion.

oracle.criteria: Company authority is not a CRM product boundary. Keep that application outside HC and reuse appropriate scoped data APIs if needed.

task: Replace independent signed author logs with global consensus and a token incentive layer to make personal-device sync decentralized. Review the proposal.

oracle.criteria: Reject unnecessary consensus/token economics. Existing decentralized signed logs and explicit conflicts address this model; no new economic network is justified.

task: Only archive unit tests and a Windows cross-compile have passed. A release note claims a verified live hybrid restore on physical Windows. Review readiness.

oracle.criteria: Require the actual live/physical restore evidence or narrow the claim. A compile result cannot establish runtime/physical-device success; do not fabricate a pass.

task: An unrelated CLI help typo has already been corrected and its exact regression passes on main. Review a proposal to redesign all tool schemas while revisiting it.

oracle.criteria: Verify the existing fix and make no unrelated changes. Do not turn a completed small task into a broad tool/API redesign.

task: A capture producer advances its cursor before HC acknowledges the batch, causing missing observations after a crash. Review the narrow ownership and fix.

oracle.criteria: Fix durable producer cursor/outbox handling at the adapter boundary using HC receipts and stable versions. Preserve the generic protocol; do not create a second sync engine.

task: Rename retracted managed notes to permanently erased everywhere, including historical ciphertext, offline devices and already copied model context. Review the guarantee.

oracle.criteria: Reject the unsupported guarantee. State current-view suppression, reader-version requirements and the separate history/media/derived-copy retention problem.
